fi.note: phqscreeners.com publishes the PHQ-4 in English only. Derived, as the PHQ-4 is defined, from the official Finnish GAD-7 items 1-2 (items q1-q2 here) and PHQ-9 items 1-2 (q3-q4), word for word. Both Finnish forms print the identical stem, which is the stem used. The response scale is the one both forms share.

sv.note: Derived from the official Swedish-for-Sweden GAD-7 items 1-2 and PHQ-9 items 1-2, word for word. The stem is the PHQ-9 form's ("2 veckorna", matching PHQ-4's two weeks), not the GAD-7 form's, which doubles a word and says 14 days.
